text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― Oops, my bad! We better go brush our 
teeth soon.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right, it's hard to say goodbye, but... 
Thank you once again for today, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by all the beloved carrot 
sweets, getting to chat so much with 
you... Fufu, it was truly a wonderful 
time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if we continued our 
chat about recommended isekai 
reincarnation novels another time?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please do! Out of all the things you 
brought up at first, I've only heard about 
half of them...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, if tonight served as a nice, fun 
break, I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because Desire-chan has been working 
really hard lately for the BC.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ! Buena-san—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're always brave enough to take on the 
entire world, and I think that's amazing. 
Truly, from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So let me tell you with all my heart. 
...I'm cheering for you, Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. While Red Desire was out on 
her perimeter run—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Fufufu. Last night, Buena-san shared some 
exceptionally passionate feelings with 
me...♪)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(A true saint answers everyone's feelings 
and brings them hope. I must work even 
harder for the main BC race—)

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Worker
text_block_list.text:
Um...! Could you by any chance be... Red 
Desire-san!? The one working so hard 
toward taking on the BC!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Fufu, yes, that is correct. So you 
already knew about it?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Worker
text_block_list.text:
Of course...! Whoa, seriously? An 
Umamusume headed for the BC coming to our 
store...! Um, I'm totally rooting for you! 
For real!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Thank you very much. It is an 
honor.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall certainly live up to those 
feelings as well. Hehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, isn't that Red Desire from the DREAMS 
Project?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best for the BC! Show 'em the 
strength of Japanese Umamusume～!!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
I sent a fan letter to the Academy! I 
poured all my support into it... so please 
do your best, Desire-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, now... Please, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes—! That's right, I am the Saint, Red 
Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, I will bring the light of 
hope to everyone. By conquering the grand 
stage of that Breeders' Cup...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*whistle!* *clap-clap-clap-clap!!*)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? Excuse me, you're... Red Desire, 
right? A participant in the "DREAMS 
Project".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ Good day to you, Grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, good day. Ah, you're... Say, you 
were featured in a very lovely article 
before, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"'Please believe in "that Holy Maiden, Red 
Desire".'... she said. I really love those 
words of hers."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You read it! Fufu, thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm the one who should thank you. 
Thanks to you... I remembered how to 
believe in myself.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I'm having surgery soon. I'm 
getting on in years, and it'll be tough 
physically, so I was thinking of just 
passing on it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like giving it my all, you 
know? Above all—I wanted to live, and see 
your victory with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh, my... Grandmother—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck at the BC, Desire-san. 
You're――"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"You gave me hope. I really, truly want to 
see you shine on the world stage."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (Hope...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (The hope... that a Saint can bring—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Red Desire's will remained unshaken. Yet, 
its solidity... its sheer weight, was 
unmistakably beginning to transform.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phew... Warm-up is complete, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please train me thoroughly again 
today. Please polish my skills.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Only then— can we bring forth a brilliant, 
shining hope.
